title: TenantPractitionerGroup
description: Represents a group entity associated with a tenant, combining group registry and tenant group details.

active.description: Indicates if the group is active

telemedicineAvailable.description: Indicates if telemedicine services are available

taxInfo.description: Represents the legal tax entity information associated with a group.

contactPerson.description: Details of the contact person for the tenant group.

externalGroupId.description: Identifier of the group in an external system.

npdbEnrollmentEnabled.description: Indicates if NPDB (National Practitioner Data Bank) enrollment is enabled for this group.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the practitioner's affiliation with the tenant group becomes effective.

endDate.description: The date when the practitioner's affiliation with the tenant group ends.

employmentType.description: The type of employment relationship the practitioner has with the tenant group.

affiliationType.description: The type of affiliation the practitioner has with the tenant group (Delegated | Direct)
